description: New turn anchored under the last answer. Chat/ChatMessageList pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/chat/ChatMessageList and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js.
